question: How is the goddess addressed as destroyer of ignorance and essence of existence?
premises: The mass of ignorance is destroyed.
The goddess is beloved of Hari.
She is the essence of the world.
inference: The goddess is praised as the destroyer of ignorance, beloved of Hari, and essence of worldly existence.
plain_english: O goddess, in whom the mass of ignorance is destroyed, beloved of Hari, essence of the world.
